# Command reference

## check

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 check [-h] [--ci] [--pending-anchor-ok] [--json] [--root ROOT]
                       [--project PROJECT]

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --ci                 enforce and name the store's recorded CI policy
  --pending-anchor-ok  exit successfully when the only mechanical NOT-CHECKED row is
                       check.evidence-anchors reporting no workflow run claim
  --json               emit one JSON report instead of text
  --root ROOT          store root directory (default: current directory)
  --project PROJECT    project root for acceptance-pack file verification (default: parent of
                       --root when its basename is .vouch)
```

## formal

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 formal [-h] [--root ROOT] [--actor ACTOR] [--record]

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT    store root directory (required with --record)
  --actor ACTOR  recorded actor claim (default: OS user)
  --record       record the passing formal certificate in the store
```

## bundle-inventory

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 bundle-inventory [-h] --root ROOT --tree TREE [--exclude PATTERN] [--json]

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT        store root directory
  --tree TREE        directory tree to inventory
  --exclude PATTERN  exclude a path pattern (repeatable)
  --json             emit one JSON result instead of text
```

## upgrade

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 upgrade [-h] [--root ROOT] [--actor ACTOR] [--dry-run] [--was-published NAME@V]
                         [--never-published NAME@V]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --root ROOT           store root directory (default: current directory)
  --actor ACTOR         recorded actor claim for the pre-log checkpoint (default: OS user)
  --dry-run             show required format steps without changing the store
  --was-published NAME@V
                        assert that an ambiguous legacy unit was previously published
  --never-published NAME@V
                        assert that an ambiguous legacy unit was never published
```

## self-check

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 self-check [-h] [--expect EXPECT]

options:
  -h, --help       show this help message and exit
  --expect EXPECT  a 64-hex digest, or @PATH to a config.json carrying lock_digest; exit 1 unless
                   the running lock's digest matches
```

## init

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 init [-h] --project PROJECT [--tier {lightweight,standard,high}]
                      [--lock LOCK_PATH] [--actor ACTOR]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT     target project directory
  --tier {lightweight,standard,high}
                        initial assurance tier (default: lightweight)
  --lock LOCK_PATH      existing lock to vendor instead of building/copying the running code
  --actor ACTOR         recorded actor claim (default: OS user)

Exit codes: 0 initialized; 2 refused with nothing written; 3 suggestion files
written—review/replace them and rerun init.
```

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 mcp [-h] --root ROOT

options:

```

## hook

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 hook [-h] [--edit-target EDIT_TARGET]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --edit-target EDIT_TARGET
                        edited file or directory; absent reads tool_input.file_path from stdin
                        JSON
```

## migrate

```text
usage: vouch-mk2 migrate [-h] --ledger LEDGER [--anchor-mode {none,ci}] [--actor ACTOR]
                         [--config CONFIG] [--drop-qualified] [--approve] [--target TARGET]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --ledger LEDGER       0.6 ledger JSON path
  --anchor-mode {none,ci}
                        mk2 anchor mode (overrides --config)
  --actor ACTOR         recorded actor claim (default: OS user)
  --config CONFIG       optional 0.6 config.json carrying anchor.mode and its legacy tier
  --drop-qualified      report and omit unrepresentable qualified releases
  --approve             write the validated candidate to a fresh target/.vouch
  --target TARGET       existing target project directory (required with --approve)
```
